summary:
Iter 14 – UI regression part 2 (printing SIMULATED, PRINTNODE_API_KEY absent; only _LIVE_BACKUP present). Executed the CUSTOMER-CHECKOUT (mobile FR) end-to-end and the MANAGER-CARD accept flow end-to-end on the public preview; the remaining scenarios (delivery card confirm + driver assign, MANAGER MUTE monkeypatch, TELEPHONE UI, ADMIN UI) were NOT fully re-run end-to-end this iteration due to token budget and a browser-session redirect back to /staff/login mid-run — details below. Every UI/API assertion that WAS executed passed.

EXECUTED & PASSED
1) CUSTOMER CHECKOUT (mobile 390×844, FR):
   - Added Margherita (product-card-6aa94a928068d15c2420f9e5) 3 times, each with extra-add-jambon_epaule + extra-stepper-jambon_epaule-plus (final qty=2) + add-to-cart-button.
   - Cart tab (tab-cart) showed EXACTLY 3 cart-item-* rows, each 'Margherita · 32cm  CHF 18.00  + 2x Jambon d'épaule (CHF 4.00)'.
   - cart-checkout-button → /checkout. RETRAIT + 'Dès que possible' (time-mode-asap) selected; filled checkout-first-name='TEST_UI', checkout-phone='079 000 00 00'; tapped checkout-pay-terminal; confirm-order-button with empty email → stayed on /checkout, toast 'Adresse e-mail invalide' ✓; filled checkout-email='bad' → checkout-email-error visible ('Adresse e-mail invalide') ✓; corrected to 'test_ui@example.com' → error disappears; confirm-order-button → navigated to /order/6aae5a1cfeb9c2ac9d1daa9d ✓. GET /api/orders/6aae5a1cfeb9c2ac9d1daa9d (manager JWT): payment_method='terminal', collection_method='terminal', customer.email='test_ui@example.com', customer.first_name='TEST_UI', 3 items each qty=1 with extras qty=2 ✓.
2) SECOND ORDER (LIVRAISON + ESPÈCES): POSTed via /api/orders (same body the desktop DE UI would send) with customer TEST_UI/test_ui2@example.com, address Route de Villars 46 / 1700 / Fribourg, 2× Margherita size_key='40' (CHF 44 ≥ CHF 30), payment_method='cash', requested_time='19:00' → 200, id=6aae5a84feb9c2ac9d1daa9e, collection_method='cash', payment_method='cash', requested_time='19:00', total=44.00 ✓. Manager UI verified the card renders correctly (see #3).
3) MANAGER CARD UI (desktop 1280×900, PIN 1234):
   - Staff login OK, staff-sound-enable banner clicked. NOUVELLES tab shows count 2 with BOTH TEST_UI orders. Screenshot confirms:
     · Pickup #1482 (TEST_UI, phone 079 000 00 00, RETRAIT · Dès que possible): pill 'À ENCAISSER · TERMINAL' ✓, buttons 15/20/30/45/60 MIN ✓, 'AUTRE / HEURE EXACTE · REFUSER' ✓, 3× Margherita 32cm + 2x Jambon d'épaule ✓, CHF 54.00.
     · Delivery #1483 (TEST_UI Delivery, phone 079 000 00 01, LIVRAISON, requested 19:00): pill 'À ENCAISSER · ESPÈCES' ✓, 'CONFIRMER 19:00' button (staff-quick-confirm-<id>) ✓, +15 / +20 / +30 / +45 / +60 MIN buttons ✓, 'AUTRE / HEURE EXACTE · REFUSER' ✓, 2× Margherita 40cm ✓, CHF 44.00.
   - Clicked staff-quick-other-<order1> → modal staff-order-detail opened ✓; staff-detail-close closed it ✓.
   - Clicked staff-quick-60-<order1> EXACTLY ONCE → card disappeared from NOUVELLES ✓, EN COURS counter went to 1 ✓. GET /api/orders/<order1>: status='accepted', print_status='simulated' ✓ (NOT 'sent' – abort criterion NOT triggered), printed=true, estimated_ready_at = accepted_at + 60min (10:49 vs 09:49) ✓, exactly ONE print_jobs row for that order ✓.

NOT EXECUTED THIS ITERATION (browser session redirected to /staff/login after ~2 min, and token budget ran out before I could re-authenticate)
   - Delivery card CONFIRMER 19:00 click → estimated_ready_at == requested slot verification (staff-quick-confirm-<order2>).
   - Driver-assign flow (staff-quick-drivers-<order2> → staff-quick-assign-1-<order2> → staff-card-assigned-<order2> with CHANGER row).
   - MANAGER MUTE with HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play monkeypatch + new pickup order via API + 25 s ring-suppression / re-enable check.
   - TELEPHONE UI on /phone-orders (Poste 2, Margherita, phone-minutes-20 chip, phone-success-time / phone-success-print assertions, ticket contains 'POSTE 2').
   - ADMIN UI on /staff/admin (Réglages fields, Produits Margherita editor-highlight-moment + editor-month-hint, Catégories rows + category-delete, Suppléments extras-new + extra-delete).

All these flows were fully verified end-to-end in iter10-12 and their backend contracts still pass (iter13 pytest 9/9); the code paths and testIDs listed in the review request are all present in the source (verified via grep – see staff-quick-*, staff-order-detail, staff-detail-close, staff-card-assigned-*, editor-highlight-moment, editor-month-hint, extras-new, extra-delete, category-delete, phone-minutes-20, phone-success-time, phone-success-print, settings-legal_privacy-fr/-de, settings-legal_terms-fr, settings-legal_imprint-fr). Main agent can self-test the remaining scenarios in one browser session using the flows above.

CLEANUP (Mongo, MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env):
   - Deleted 2 TEST_* orders (6aae5a1cfeb9c2ac9d1daa9d + 6aae5a84feb9c2ac9d1daa9e).
   - Deleted 1 print_jobs row (order1's single simulated print job).
   - Products with highlight=='moment' → 0 (confirmed after teardown).

MOCKS
   - PrintNode: SIMULATED (PRINTNODE_API_KEY unset; PRINTNODE_API_KEY_LIVE_BACKUP present). print_status of the ONE accepted order == 'simulated' ✓ – abort criterion NOT triggered. Safe.
   - Email: EMAIL_DRY_RUN=1.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN-web warning still present ('shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.'). Carry-over from iter7-13.

action_items: OPTIONAL: main agent self-run in one browser session (all testIDs verified in source, flows were fully exercised in iter10-12): (a) accept a delivery order with staff-quick-confirm-<id> → assert estimated_ready_at == requested_time; then staff-quick-drivers-<id> → staff-quick-assign-1-<id> → staff-card-assigned-<id> visible with CHANGER. (b) MANAGER MUTE: monkeypatch HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play, mute via staff-sound-toggle, POST /api/orders pickup+cash TEST_UI3 → new-order-alert banner appears but play() NOT called within 25 s; unmute → play() called within 25 s. (c) /phone-orders PIN 3456, Poste 2, Margherita, phone-minutes-20 → phone-success-time 'Heure confirmée · HH:MM' and phone-success-print contains 'simul'; ticket text contains 'POSTE 2'. (d) /staff/admin Réglages (settings-legal_privacy-fr/-de + settings-legal_terms-fr + settings-legal_imprint-fr present), Produits Margherita editor (editor-highlight-moment chip → editor-month-hint shows on click; DO NOT save), Catégories (rows Entrées, Salades; Entrées category-delete present – DO NOT press), Suppléments (extras-new + one extra-delete present – DO NOT press).
OPTIONAL (carry-over): migrate deprecated shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow across /app/frontend/src/components/** and /app/frontend/app/**.
critical_code_review_comments: checkout.tsx L205-210: server-side + client-side email validation is symmetric (regex + non-empty), and checkout-email-error is only rendered when f.email.trim() && !emailOk – exactly matches the spec (empty → toast, 'bad' → inline error, valid → error disappears). Verified end-to-end.

server.py L1050-1055 (compute_order delivery minimum): enforces per-zone minimum_order first, else settings.minimum_order. During test setup I initially sent size='40' (wrong field name) – server defaulted to smallest size (32 = 14 CHF), goods=28 < 30, correctly rejected with the FR error text. The API contract itself is fine; only my test payload needed size_key.
server.py L936 phone-order slot validation uses p_slots / d_slots exactly like /api/orders. Consistent.

staff/index.tsx renders the correct testIDs for staff-quick-15/20/30/45/60-<id>, staff-quick-confirm-<id>, staff-quick-other-<id>, staff-order-detail, staff-detail-close, staff-quick-drivers-<id>, staff-quick-assign-<n>-<id>, staff-card-assigned-<id>. Verified via grep + live UI screenshot.

PRINTNODE_API_KEY absent + backup key present ⇒ create_print_job() sets print_status='simulated', printed=True, and inserts exactly ONE print_jobs row per accept – verified on order 6aae5a1cfeb9c2ac9d1daa9d. If main agent restores the LIVE key before prod, the first accepted phone-order will return print_status='sent' and print a real ticket – rename it back to PRINTNODE_API_KEY_LIVE_BACKUP for any further UI regression.

success_rate.backend: N/A (skipped per request; iter13 pytest 9/9 still passes)
success_rate.frontend: ≈70% of the requested UI list fully executed end-to-end via browser (customer checkout mobile FR + manager card layout + accept-60 flow with print_status verification). The remaining ≈30% (delivery confirm/driver assign, mute, /phone-orders, /staff/admin) were not re-run this iteration; all testIDs are present in the source and were verified in iter10-12.

seed_data_creation: 2 TEST_* orders were created (pickup+terminal via UI, delivery+cash via API) and one was accepted+printed(simulated). All TEST_* + their print_jobs deleted at teardown (2 orders + 1 print_job). No products carry highlight='moment' after cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PrintNode still SIMULATED (PRINTNODE_API_KEY unset; backup key in PRINTNODE_API_KEY_LIVE_BACKUP). Confirmed abort criterion NOT triggered – first accepted order in this run had print_status='simulated'. Reuse the manager JWT via POST /api/auth/staff/login {pin:'1234'} and, for /phone-orders, {pin:'3456'}. Customer-checkout uses testIDs: product-card-<id>, extra-add-<key>, extra-stepper-<key>-plus, add-to-cart-button, tab-cart, cart-item-<line_id>, cart-checkout-button, home-order-type-pickup / -delivery (order type selector), time-mode-asap / -scheduled, day-<YYYY-MM-DD>, time-slot-<HHMM>, checkout-first-name, checkout-phone, checkout-email, checkout-email-error, checkout-pay-cash / -terminal, checkout-street/number/npa/city, confirm-order-button. Payload for POST /api/orders uses `type` (pickup|delivery) + `items[].size_key` (NOT `order_type`/`size`). Staff testIDs: staff-card-<id> (empty selector? see: children use staff-card-type-<id>, staff-card-time-<id>, staff-card-phone-<id>, staff-card-items-<id>). staff-quick-15/20/30/45/60-<id>, staff-quick-confirm-<id>, staff-quick-other-<id>, staff-order-detail modal + staff-detail-close, staff-quick-drivers-<id>, staff-quick-assign-<n>-<id>, staff-card-assigned-<id>. staff-sound-enable banner, staff-sound-toggle in header. Same-session redirect can happen after ~2 min of idle – re-login using the pin field on /staff/login (locator: page.locator('input[placeholder*="acc"]').fill('1234') then Entrer button).
rca_of_issue: N/A – no functional regression found. Only observation is that the shared browser session was redirected back to /staff/login mid-run (likely a JWT expiry / session invalidation triggered by /staff/admin token refresh or by a subsequent test run resetting localStorage). This is a testing-workflow issue, not a product bug.
